numbers this morning: signups yesterday 312 (+24% vs last Thursday), trial to paid 3.1%, signup time 0.9 s (was 4.1 s)
GitHub: 1,284 stars (+96 since yesterday), 6 open PRs. our Show HN is #7 on the front page with 182 points, 64 comments
support load is fine: 14 tickets yesterday, median first reply 22 min
go for dark mode on Monday. @camille can the weekly update carry these numbers?

Install bug: after the install script, `acme` isn't found in fish. The script adds the PATH line to .bashrc and .zshrc only, nothing in ~/.config/fish/config.fish.
Second one: behind our corporate proxy (HTTPS_PROXY set) the CLI times out after 30 s on `acme sync`. curl to the API works with the same proxy.
Et une demande : est-ce que les réponses de l'assistant pourraient être en français quand on lui écrit en français ? Toute l'équipe est à Lyon.
